cases.description: Position is opened (no exit trade) and entry is a BUY (isSell() == false). Gross profit should be amount * finalPrice - entryValue = 10 * 7 - 50 = 20.
Opened long position where finalPrice equals entry price, resulting in zero gross profit.
Opened long position with a final price lower than entry price, producing a negative gross profit (loss).
Position is opened and entry is a SELL (isSell() == true). Gross profit is negated, so profit = -(amount * finalPrice - entryValue) = -(70‑50) = -20.
Opened short position where finalPrice equals entry price; after negation the profit is zero.
Opened short position with finalPrice lower than entry price; after negation the profit becomes positive (gain).
Position is closed (exit trade present) and entry is a BUY. Gross profit = exitValue - entryValue = 80‑50 = 30. finalPrice is ignored for closed positions, so NaN is supplied.
Closed position where entry is a SELL. Gross profit = -(exitValue - entryValue) = -(80‑50) = -30.

group: Opened Position - Long with NaN finalPrice

cases.description: Opened long position (entry BUY) with finalPrice = NaN. amount * NaN yields NaN, NaN - entryValue is NaN, no negation applied.

group: Opened Position - Short with NaN finalPrice

cases.description: Opened short position (entry SELL) with finalPrice = NaN. amount * NaN = NaN, NaN - entryValue = NaN, then negated still NaN.

group: Closed Position - Long with non‑NaN finalPrice

cases.description: Closed long position where exit trade exists. finalPrice is ignored; gross profit = exitValue - entryValue = 80‑50 = 30.

group: Closed Position - Short with non‑NaN finalPrice

cases.description: Closed short position where exit trade exists. finalPrice is ignored; gross profit = -(exitValue - entryValue) = -(80‑50) = -30.
Long position with entry amount = 0. Profit = 0 * finalPrice - entryValue (0) = 0.
Short position with entry amount = 0. amount * finalPrice - entryValue = 0, negated still 0.

group: Opened Position - Long Zero Entry Value

cases.description: Long position where entry value = 0 (price 0). Profit = amount * finalPrice - 0 = 10 * 5 = 50.

group: Opened Position - Short Zero Entry Value

cases.description: Short position with entry value = 0. Gross profit = -(amount * finalPrice - 0) = -(10*5) = -50.

group: Opened Position - Long Negative Final Price

cases.description: Long position with negative finalPrice. Profit = 10 * (-5) - 50 = -100.

group: Opened Position - Short Negative Final Price

cases.description: Short position with negative finalPrice. Gross profit = -(10 * (-5) - 50) = 100.
Closed long position where exitValue (50) < entryValue (80). Gross profit = 50‑80 = -30.
Closed short position where exitValue (50) < entryValue (80). Gross profit = -(50‑80) = 30.
Position is opened (isOpened() == true) but the entry trade reference is null. Accessing entry.getAmount() should throw a NullPointerException.
Position is closed (isOpened() == false) but the exit trade reference is null. Accessing exit.getValue() should throw a NullPointerException.
The finalPrice argument is null. entry.getAmount().multipliedBy(null) triggers a NullPointerException.
The entry trade exists but its amount field is null. entry.getAmount().multipliedBy(finalPrice) causes a NullPointerException.
The entry trade exists but its value field is null. The subtraction entry.getAmount().multipliedBy(finalPrice).minus(entry.getValue()) triggers a NullPointerException.
The position is closed, exit trade exists but its value field is null. exit.getValue().minus(entry.getValue()) throws a NullPointerException.
The position is closed, entry trade exists but its value field is null. exit.getValue().minus(entry.getValue()) triggers a NullPointerException.
